note: K5 script-call phrases (MED-304): the 10 Swahili phrases Mahs reads on one call to SIA, in order, for the word error rate (deno task wer). Swahili checked by Mahs on 7 Oct. Amounts and dates are exactly as _shared/sw.ts says them.

phrases.sw: Pasipoti ya kurasa thelathini na nne inagharimu shilingi elfu saba mia tano na hamsini.

phrases.en: Registering a business name costs KES 950, and it usually takes one to two days.
phrases.sw: Kusajili jina la biashara ni shilingi mia tisa na hamsini, na kwa kawaida huchukua siku moja hadi mbili.
Pasipoti ya kurasa sitini na sita inagharimu shilingi elfu kumi na mbili na hamsini.
phrases.review: sw: sw.ts says 'elfu kumi na mbili na hamsini'; is that how you would say 12,050?

phrases.en: Your biometrics appointment is on Thursday, 15 October 2026, in the morning, between 8 and 12.
phrases.sw: Miadi yako ya biometriki ni Alhamisi, tarehe kumi na tano Oktoba, mwaka elfu mbili na ishirini na sita, asubuhi, kati ya saa mbili na saa sita.
phrases.check: PP-03. Date and Swahili hours (8 am is saa mbili).

phrases.en: You can ask for a review until Wednesday, 31 March 2027.
phrases.sw: Unaweza kuomba mapitio hadi Jumatano, tarehe thelathini na moja Machi, mwaka elfu mbili na ishirini na saba.

phrases.en: Your resident number is Q K, twenty, forty-one, thirty-three, seventy-six.
phrases.sw: Namba yako ya mkazi ni Q K, ishirini, arobaini na moja, thelathini na tatu, sabini na sita.
phrases.check: QK-2041-3376 read in pairs, a short pause between pairs.
phrases.review: sw: Q K as English letters (kyu, kei) or Swahili letter names?

phrases.en: I'll send it to zone three, block B twelve, plot forty-seven, unit two. Is that right?
phrases.sw: Nitaituma eneo la tatu, bloku B kumi na mbili, kiwanja arobaini na saba, nyumba namba mbili. Ni sawa?
phrases.check: Z3 B12 P047 U02, spoken as in world.md section 3.
phrases.review: sw: 'eneo', 'bloku', 'kiwanja', 'nyumba namba' for zone, block, plot, unit? This becomes the Swahili address format in the read-back.

phrases.en: To act for your daughter Imani, I need your consent first. It lasts 12 months or until she turns 18, whichever comes first.
phrases.sw: Ili nimsaidie binti yako Imani, nahitaji ridhaa yako kwanza. Inadumu miezi kumi na miwili au hadi atakapotimiza miaka kumi na minane, kipi kitakachotangulia.
phrases.check: Charter 3.1. Child by first name only.
phrases.review: sw: 'miezi kumi na miwili' and 'miaka kumi na minane' agree with the noun class; sw.ts would say 'kumi na mbili' and 'kumi na nane'. If agreement is right, MED-301 adds noun-class numbers to sw.ts.

phrases.en: Here is what will happen: you pay KES 7,550 for a 34-page passport renewal. Shall I go ahead?
phrases.sw: Hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa: utalipa shilingi elfu saba mia tano na hamsini kwa kurenew pasipoti ya kurasa thelathini na nne. Niendelee?
phrases.check: Read-back before payment: amount and item exact, then a question.

phrases.en: I can't approve that, and I won't guess. An officer will decide, usually within 2 working days, and you'll get the reason in writing.
phrases.sw: Siwezi kuidhinisha hilo, na sitakisia. Afisa ataamua, kwa kawaida ndani ya siku mbili za kazi, na utapata sababu kwa maandishi.
